candidates.title: Recreational Water Advisories
candidates.description: Data on advisories issued for water quality problems in selected recreational water areas.

candidates.title: Awarded Vendor Contact Info
candidates.description: Vendors currently under award for a contract with the State of Delaware to include vendor contact information, vendor website, links to contracts awarded, and certification of vendors by Office of Supplier Diversity if applicable.

candidates.title: Open Space Program Land Inventory
candidates.description: A listing of properties protected and /or acquired under the Delaware Open Space Program.

candidates.title: Freshwater Pond Fish Community Surveys
candidates.description: Results of annual fish population surveys on Delaware's publicly-accessible freshwater ponds and lakes. Surveys can be affected by weather, access, and other factors and may not directly reflect fish populations. For interpretation and further research, please see reports from the Division of Fish and Wildlife.

candidates.title: Delaware Fishing Licenses and Trout Stamps
candidates.description: Total numbers of fishing licenses and trout stamps issued, by year and by residence status.

candidates.title: Toxics Release Inventory
candidates.description: Contains information about toxic chemicals in Delaware, based on annual reports from facilities that use or manufacture covered chemicals. These facilities report their data to both the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and the State of Delaware. DNREC reviews Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) reports received from Delaware facilities. The EPA publishes national TRI reports annually and provides a searchable database.

candidates.title: DNREC Events
candidates.description: A listing of events hosted by or sponsored by the Delaware Department of Natural Resources and Environmental Control in XML format.

candidates.title: State Park Programs
candidates.description: Listing of public programs offered in Delaware State Parks.

candidates.title: DE NIBRS Most Common Offenses (Using Statewide Totals)
candidates.description: Displays the top six offenses (based off of Statewide totals) over time for a given jurisdiction.

candidates.title: Delaware Boat Registrations by Year
candidates.description: This dataset contains summary count information for boat registrations issued each year by the State of Delaware. A registration can be valid for 1 or 3 years. A boat registration is only counted once based upon the year of its expiration date. If a boat registration is for 3 years, it is included in only the expiration year summary count.
